# LJR Dev — Lucas Ralph

> Software engineer building developer tools, AI agents, and full-stack applications.

## About

Lucas Ralph is a software engineer specializing in Next.js, TypeScript, and agentic AI workflows. He builds developer tooling, CLI applications, and autonomous agent systems. Currently a Developer Success Engineer at Vercel.

## Blog

The blog at /blog covers AI agents, developer tooling, CLI design, and automation. Posts are written in markdown and served from a headless CMS.

- RSS feed: /blog/rss.xml
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Key Topics

- AI agent orchestration and overnight autonomous research
- Developer tooling and CLI design patterns
- Next.js, React, and full-stack TypeScript
- Browser automation for AI agents
- Local-first development workflows
